title: [3.4] Changing loop status from AAPS client does not work
body:
Maybe related to #4463 but not quite the same issue so I open a new issue.
I was testing the change of loop status from AAPS client, and for me, changing loop status from AAPSclient never does anything on main AAPS.
In NsClientv3 tab on main AAPS, I see the Create Treatment with mode= DISABLED_LOOP but nothing else seems to happen.

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24421322/AndroidAPS.log)

comments.body: There is a new setting in NSClient settings which you need to enable. It could perhaps be useful to add that to release notes.

Ok, I will update the docs accordingly then. But still, the display when
the setting is not enabled is wrong. It lets you think, from aapsclient,
that the status change succeeded. Not like a profile change where
aapsclient only shows what aaps has reported doing.
